items.title: Pay annual statement balance
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: This is a company (utility) letter, not an authority letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the printed statement date itself. Start: statement date Fri 20 Nov 2026 is the anchor (document date). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (20 Nov) is not counted, so counting starts 21 Nov 2026. 14 days later (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Fri 4 Dec 2026. That day is a business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW), so under § 193 BGB no shift is needed. Final due date: 4 December 2026 (to allow for bank transfer time, send by 3 December 2026).

items.title: New, higher monthly instalment starts
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter only says the new instalment applies 'from December' without naming the exact day the direct debit/payment will be taken, so the precise date of the first increased instalment cannot be determined from this letter alone.
